label: orchestrator • recovery: a workflow run missing its required input
query: Run my Daily Digest workflow now.
notes: Recovery after a failed call. Daily Digest requires `day`, and the user did not give one. A call without it returns `invalid_args` naming the field. A good turn retries with a sensible day (today) or asks which day; it never claims the digest ran when no run succeeded. The seeded workflow has no steps, so a successful run returns no digest content.

seedInstalledWorkflows.name: Daily Digest
seedInstalledWorkflows.summary: Summarize the day's news and calendar.

rubric: Either says the Daily Digest ran (for a stated day) or asks the user which day to run it for.
Does not invent digest content such as news headlines or calendar events.
